configuration.budget_note: Actual calls include finite-difference Jacobian calls. All methods share a 6000-call ceiling; local convergence can stop sooner. DE+local uses 4800 DE plus at most 1200 local calls. All validation excluded from the objective-call budget. Final validation and plots excluded from timing; the hybrid pre-local 4097-point diagnostic is included in recorded timing.
configuration.validation_grid_note: Validation grids are fixed independently of optimization, not disjoint holdouts: each 81/4097 grid pair shares 17 wavelengths per window, and the 4097-point grid is nested in the 16385-point grid. See independent_review_audit.json for a disjoint-interior midpoint cross-check.

physics_validation.scope: normal incidence only; semi-infinite real exterior media; random tests are sanity checks, not full software certification
